description: International postal tracking number check (UPU S10 format, e.g. RR123456785GB): validates the 8-digit serial with the S10 check digit, decodes the service type from the first letter (EMS, registered, parcel, insured...), names the origin postal country from the last two letters, and returns tracking links (origin post and multi-carrier trackers). It does not read the item's live scan history. Choose this tool for: International postal tracking number check: validates. Close alternatives on this server: logistics_container_tracking (Shipping container number check: validates an ISO 6346); logistics_last_mile_courier (Identify the courier behind a tracking number from its). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
